claim.claim-text: 2. The airfoil assembly as recited in claim 1, wherein the seal plate (80) is ceramic.
3. The airfoil assembly as recited in claim 1 or 2, wherein the seal plate (80) is secured to the fairing platform (66) by at least one fastener (84).

4. The airfoil assembly as recited in claim 3, wherein the seal plate (80) includes first and second plate pieces (80a, 80b), the fairing platform (66) is sandwiched between the first and second plate pieces (80a, 80b), and the at least one fastener (84) extends through the first and second plate pieces (80a, 80b) and the fairing platform (66).

5. The airfoil assembly as recited in claim 4, wherein the fairing platform (66) includes at least one hole (90) in which the at least one fastener (84) is disposed, and at least one of the first or second plate pieces (80a, 80b) includes a dimple (94) that extends into the at least one hole (90).

6. The airfoil assembly as recited in claim 4, wherein the fairing platform (66) includes at least one hole (90) in which the at least one fastener (84) is disposed, and at least one of the first or second plate pieces (80a, 80b) includes an upstanding boss (96) that extends over the at least one hole (90).

7. The airfoil assembly as recited in any preceding claim, further comprising a baffle (73) that extends in the hollow airfoil section (64), the baffle (73) has a baffle periphery (73a), the seal plate (80) includes an additional opening (82b) having an additional opening periphery (82b-1) that is complementary to the baffle periphery (73a), and the baffle (73) extends through the additional opening (82b).
8. The airfoil assembly as recited in claim 7, wherein there is an additional seal (86b) between the baffle (73) and the seal plate (80).

9. The airfoil assembly as recited in any preceding claim, wherein the fairing platform (66) is hollow and includes inner and outer walls (77a, 77b) that are radially-spaced apart and define a plenum (78) therebetween, and the seal plate (80) is secured to the outer wall (77b).

10. The airfoil assembly as recited in any preceding claim, wherein the fairing platform (66) defines opposed first and second sides (77e, 77f), and the fairing platform (66) is open-sided at the opposed first and second sides (77e, 77f).
11. The airfoil assembly as recited in any preceding claim, wherein the seal (86a) seals completely around the spar leg periphery (72d).
